title: Lab - Service accounts
description: Give a dashboard its own identity.
scenario: Give a dashboard its own identity. This lab is a skeleton: the tasks name what to do and how to check it; work them on your own cluster and expand your notes as you go.
environment_setup:
# A three-node kind cluster is enough for this lab
cat <<'EOF' > kind-cka.yaml
kind: Cluster
apiVersion: kind.x-k8s.io/v1alpha4
name: cka
nodes:
  - role: control-plane
  - role: worker
  - role: worker
EOF
kind create cluster --config kind-cka.yaml
kubectl get nodes
cleanup:
kind delete cluster --name cka
rm -f kind-cka.yaml

tasks.title: Task 1 - Create
tasks.instructions: Create service account dashboard-sa and inspect it.
tasks.solution:
kubectl create sa dashboard-sa
kubectl describe sa dashboard-sa

tasks.title: Task 2 - Token
tasks.instructions: Generate a token for it and call the API with it.
tasks.solution:
TOKEN=$(kubectl create token dashboard-sa)
curl -sk https://<apiserver>:6443/api -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"

tasks.title: Task 3 - Use it
tasks.instructions: Make Deployment web-dashboard run with dashboard-sa and grant it list pods via a Role.
tasks.solution: kubectl set serviceaccount deploy web-dashboard dashboard-sa
